contradiction.claim: Marked essays in the Staff Room from about 15:15 until 17:00 and never left it.

explanation: Julia slipped out of the Staff Room, entered the Exams Office at 16:12, unlocked the cabinet with her own key (clue 2), and hid the papers in the Staff Room recycling box (clue 3) when she returned at 16:19. Her son sits the exam on Monday. Ethan's photocopied paper (clue 1) is a red herring: it is last year's paper from the Library, and the log keeps him in the Library all afternoon.
